exposure: Maternal emotional regulation strategy (cognitive reappraisal, expressive suppression)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 965 mothers from Chongqing municipality, Guangzhou city, and Huizhou city in China, who were surveyed regarding feeding practices and emotional regulation strategies within 72 hours of delivery.
finding: Women with expressive suppression were less likely to practice exclusive breastfeeding, while receiving breastfeeding education was positively associated with exclusive breastfeeding.
